symptom: A Tree node (3.4.0) created without a data source failed mx check 11.16.1 with CE0463 'definition of this widget has changed' instead of the CE0642 'Data source is required' that check's MDL-WIDGET56 warning predicts; mx update-widgets changed only headerCaption's TextTemplate, null -> empty ClientTemplate. With a data source set the page built clean on main too.
cause: NullTemplatesOfUnsetDataSources (#1967) nulled every unset TextTemplate bound to an unset data source, but #1967 was measured on an OPTIONAL data source (required="false"); Tree node's datasource declares no required attribute, so it is required, and for a required one Studio Pro keeps the empty template. The #1967 finding even notes TreeNode binds to a required data source, without the code checking it.
fix: Skip the nulling when the bound data source's PropertyTypeIDEntry is Required.
insight: Found by placing every generated widget example on a page and labelling each CE0463 with docker check's update-widgets re-check, then bson dump page before/after mx update-widgets on a copy: one TextTemplate differed. A rule measured on one widget's shape (optional data source) generalised past what was measured; when a finding names the cases it did NOT cover, the code should refuse those cases, not just the prose.
test: mdl/backend/widgetobj/unset_datasource_templates_test.go TestNullTemplatesOfUnsetDataSources_RequiredDataSourceKeepsItsTemplate (failed before the guard); #1967's own case still nulls; live: Tree node example 1 CE0463 -> CE0642 only, with a data source 0 errors
